A rank-four nine-element counterexample to Lason common-basis conjecture

Myeongjin Kang

Abstract

An actual rank4 matroid on9 labeled elements, with k2 and x1,y6, has two-base partitions of both deletions but no choices of such partitions share a base. Parallel elements permitted by source; full literal conjecture negation.

AI-assisted research preprint. The scoped main statement has a Lean certificate. Internal AI review is not external journal peer review; bounded prior-art searches do not certify worldwide priority. See the paper for exact qualifications and formalization limits.
